title: Umbrella in Clockwork Rain
description: A green lizard-like creature stands in the center of a surreal corridor holding a bright red umbrella while rain falls. The floor and stairs are covered with dozens of scattered clocks and pocket watches, with glowing bubbles and twisted trees lining the recursive arched passageways.
prompt: A green anthropomorphic lizard creature walking away down the center of a surreal recursive hallway made of twisted trees and glowing arches, holding a bright red umbrella as rain pours down. The ground is littered with numerous scattered clocks and pocket watches. Iridescent bubbles and sparkles float throughout the scene. Dreamlike fantasy atmosphere with purple and teal color palette, whimsical and mysterious.
